VERSION 3.28.0.172
; Study heatmap widget for qMarkable Home.
;  - Today's study time (notebooks + PDFs)
;  - GitHub-style year grid in 5 gray shades (minutes in notebooks/PDFs)
;  - One calendar year (Jan–Jun / Jul–Dec); swipe the grid sideways to change year
;  - Tap a day to pick it; a collapsible panel shows
;    that day's hourly bar chart and per-notebook totals
;
; Data comes from qmarkable-trackerd (see tracker/). This file tells the
; tracker when a notebook/PDF is on screen by writing /run/qmarkable/current-doc
; (tmpfs: RAM only, no flash writes).
;
; Requires: qmarkableHome.qmd, xovi + qt-resource-rebuilder. Firmware 3.28.0.172.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/main/MainView.qml
    TRAVERSE Background#root > FocusScope#rootItem > FocusScope#viewRoot
        LOCATE BEFORE Item#connectivityNotifierContainer
        INSERT {
            Item {
                id: qmDocMarker
                visible: false

                // Bindings re-evaluate whenever any input changes. Time counts
                // only while a notebook or PDF is on screen: awake, not covered
                // by the homepage, not locked. Ebooks are not counted.
                readonly property var doc: documentView.item ? documentView.item.document : null
                readonly property bool counting: !!doc
                    && (doc.fileType === Document.FileType.Notebook || doc.fileType === Document.FileType.Pdf)
                    && BatteryManager.displayState === BatteryManager.Normal
                    && root.qmHomeVisible !== true
                    && !root.passcodeHandler.userLocked
                readonly property string payload: counting
                    ? ("" + doc.id) + "\n" + ("" + (doc.visibleName || "")).split("\n").join(" ") + "\n"
                    : "\n"   // "not counting"; an empty PUT body would create no file

                function write(text) {
                    var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
                    x.open("PUT", "file:///run/qmarkable/current-doc");
                    x.send(text);
                }

                onPayloadChanged: {
                    write(payload);
                    console.log("[qmarkable] counting: " + (counting ? doc.id : "no"));
                }
                Component.onCompleted: {
                    write(payload);
                    console.log("[qmarkable] study tracker marker ready");
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

SLOT qmHomeWidgets
    INSERT {
        Column {
            id: qmHeat
            width: parent.width
            spacing: 18

            readonly property string dataDir: "file:///home/root/.local/share/qmarkable/"
            readonly property int gap: 5
            readonly property int labelW: 0
            readonly property double dayMsLen: 86400000
            readonly property var shades: ["#ffffff", "#d4d4d4", "#a0a0a0", "#5a5a5a", "#000000"]
            readonly property var monthNames: ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"]
            readonly property var dayNames: ["Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"]

            property var totals: ({})
            property int tzOff: 0
            property double todayMs: 0       // local midnight, as a UTC-epoch ms "local clock" value
            property string todayKey: ""
            property bool loaded: false

            // ---- displayed year: Jan–Jun on top, Jul–Dec below ----
            property int year: 0
            property int minYear: 0
            property int maxYear: 0
            readonly property double jan1Ms: Date.UTC(year, 0, 1)
            readonly property double jul1Ms: Date.UTC(year, 6, 1)
            readonly property int jan1Dow: new Date(jan1Ms).getUTCDay()
            readonly property int daysInYear: Math.round((Date.UTC(year + 1, 0, 1) - jan1Ms) / dayMsLen)
            readonly property int weeks: Math.ceil((jan1Dow + daysInYear) / 7)
            // week column that contains 1 July: shown in both halves (each half
            // only draws its own days), so every band starts/ends on a month edge
            readonly property int julCol: Math.floor((jan1Dow + Math.round((jul1Ms - jan1Ms) / dayMsLen)) / 7)
            readonly property int colsPerBand: Math.max(julCol + 1, weeks - julCol)
            readonly property int cell: Math.max(8, Math.floor((width - labelW - (colsPerBand - 1) * gap) / colsPerBand))
            readonly property int step: cell + gap
            readonly property int monthH: 30
            readonly property int bandH: monthH + 7 * step
            readonly property int bandGap: 18

            property string selKey: ""
            property bool detailOpen: false
            property var selHours: []
            property var selDocs: []
            property int selTotal: 0
            property int selHour: -1

            function pad(n) { return n < 10 ? "0" + n : "" + n; }
            function keyOf(ms) {
                var d = new Date(ms);
                return d.getUTCFullYear() + "-" + pad(d.getUTCMonth() + 1) + "-" + pad(d.getUTCDate());
            }
            function msOf(key) {
                var p = key.split("-");
                return Date.UTC(parseInt(p[0], 10), parseInt(p[1], 10) - 1, parseInt(p[2], 10));
            }
            function yearOf(key) { return parseInt(key.substring(0, 4), 10); }
            function fmt(secs) {
                var m = Math.round((secs || 0) / 60);
                if (m < 60) return m + "m";
                return Math.floor(m / 60) + "h " + pad(m % 60) + "m";
            }
            function level(secs) {
                var m = (secs || 0) / 60;
                if (m < 1) return 0;
                if (m < 30) return 1;
                if (m < 60) return 2;
                if (m < 120) return 3;
                return 4;
            }
            function longDate(key) {
                var d = new Date(msOf(key));
                return dayNames[d.getUTCDay()] + ", " + d.getUTCDate() + " " + monthNames[d.getUTCMonth()] + " " + d.getUTCFullYear();
            }
            // position of a day (ms) in the two-band layout
            function cellPos(ms) {
                var d = Math.round((ms - jan1Ms) / dayMsLen) + jan1Dow;
                var col = Math.floor(d / 7);
                var band = ms < jul1Ms ? 0 : 1;
                return { x: (band === 0 ? col : col - julCol) * step,
                         y: band * (bandH + bandGap) + monthH + (d % 7) * step };
            }

            function readFile(url, cb) {
                var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
                x.onreadystatechange = function() {
                    if (x.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE)
                        cb(x.status === 200 || x.status === 0 ? (x.responseText || "") : "");
                };
                x.open("GET", url);
                x.send();
            }

            function reload() {
                readFile(dataDir + "index.txt", function(text) {
                    var tot = {};
                    var first = "";
                    var off = -new Date().getTimezoneOffset();
                    var lines = text.split("\n");
                    for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
                        var line = lines[i];
                        if (line.indexOf("#") === 0) {
                            var at = line.indexOf("tzoff=");
                            if (at >= 0) off = parseInt(line.substring(at + 6), 10);
                            continue;
                        }
                        var parts = line.split(" ");
                        if (parts.length >= 2 && parts[0].length === 10) {
                            tot[parts[0]] = parseInt(parts[1], 10);
                            if (first === "" || parts[0] < first) first = parts[0];
                        }
                    }
                    var local = new Date(Date.now() + off * 60000);
                    var mid = Date.UTC(local.getUTCFullYear(), local.getUTCMonth(), local.getUTCDate());
                    qmHeat.tzOff = off;
                    qmHeat.todayMs = mid;
                    qmHeat.todayKey = keyOf(mid);
                    qmHeat.maxYear = local.getUTCFullYear();
                    qmHeat.minYear = first === "" ? qmHeat.maxYear : Math.min(yearOf(first), qmHeat.maxYear);
                    qmHeat.totals = tot;
                    if (qmHeat.year === 0 || qmHeat.year > qmHeat.maxYear)
                        qmHeat.year = qmHeat.maxYear;
                    qmHeat.loaded = true;
                    if (qmHeat.selKey === "") {
                        if (qmHeat.year === qmHeat.maxYear) qmHeat.select(qmHeat.todayKey, false);
                    } else {
                        qmHeat.loadDay(qmHeat.selKey);
                    }
                });
            }

            function setYear(y) {
                y = Math.max(minYear, Math.min(maxYear, y));
                if (y === year) return;
                year = y;
                if (selKey !== "" && yearOf(selKey) !== y) {
                    selKey = "";
                    detailOpen = false;
                    if (y === maxYear) select(todayKey, false);
                }
            }

            function loadDay(key) {
                readFile(dataDir + "days/" + key + ".txt", function(text) {
                    if (key !== qmHeat.selKey) return;
                    var hours = [];
                    for (var h = 0; h < 24; h++) hours.push(0);
                    var docs = [];
                    var lines = text.split("\n");
                    for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
                        var line = lines[i];
                        if (line.indexOf("a ") === 0) {
                            var v = line.substring(2).split(" ");
                            for (var j = 0; j < 24 && j < v.length; j++) hours[j] = parseInt(v[j], 10) || 0;
                        } else if (line.indexOf("d ") === 0) {
                            var rest = line.substring(2);
                            var s1 = rest.indexOf(" ");
                            var s2 = rest.indexOf(" ", s1 + 1);
                            if (s1 < 0) continue;
                            var secs = parseInt(s2 < 0 ? rest.substring(s1 + 1) : rest.substring(s1 + 1, s2), 10) || 0;
                            var name = s2 < 0 ? "(untitled)" : rest.substring(s2 + 1);
                            if (secs >= 30) docs.push({ name: name, secs: secs });
                        }
                    }
                    docs.sort(function(a, b) { return b.secs - a.secs; });
                    var total = 0;
                    for (var k = 0; k < 24; k++) total += hours[k];
                    qmHeat.selHours = hours;
                    qmHeat.selDocs = docs;
                    qmHeat.selTotal = total;
                });
            }

            function select(key, toggle) {
                if (key === "" || msOf(key) > todayMs) return;
                if (toggle && key === selKey) {
                    detailOpen = !detailOpen;
                    return;
                }
                selKey = key;
                selHour = -1;
                selHours = [];
                selDocs = [];
                selTotal = totals[key] || 0;
                if (toggle) detailOpen = true;
                loadDay(key);
            }
            function step(days) {
                if (selKey === "") return;
                var ms = msOf(selKey) + days * dayMsLen;
                if (ms > todayMs) return;
                var k = keyOf(ms);
                if (yearOf(k) < minYear) return;
                if (yearOf(k) !== year) year = yearOf(k);   // follow into the neighbouring year
                select(k, false);
            }

            Connections {
                target: qmHome
                function onVisibleChanged() { if (qmHome.visible) qmHeat.reload(); }
            }
            Component.onCompleted: reload()

            // ---- today ----
            Column {
                spacing: 0
                Text {
                    text: "today"
                    color: "#8c8c8c"
                    font.family: qmHome.mono
                    font.pixelSize: 24
                }
                Text {
                    text: qmHeat.fmt(qmHeat.totals[qmHeat.todayKey] || 0)
                    color: "black"
                    font.family: qmHome.mono
                    font.pixelSize: 84
                    font.bold: true
                    font.letterSpacing: -2
                }
            }

            // ---- year:  2026            <  > ----
            Item {
                width: parent.width
                height: 56
                Text {
                    anchors.left: parent.left
                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    text: qmHeat.year > 0 ? "" + qmHeat.year : ""
                    font.family: qmHome.mono
                    font.pixelSize: 36
                    font.bold: true
                    color: "black"
                }
                Row {
                    anchors.right: parent.right
                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    spacing: 48
                    Text {
                        text: "<"
                        font.family: qmHome.mono
                        font.pixelSize: 36
                        font.bold: true
                        color: qmHeat.year > qmHeat.minYear ? "black" : "#d4d4d4"
                        MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; anchors.margins: -22; onClicked: qmHeat.setYear(qmHeat.year - 1) }
                    }
                    Text {
                        text: ">"
                        font.family: qmHome.mono
                        font.pixelSize: 36
                        font.bold: true
                        color: qmHeat.year < qmHeat.maxYear ? "black" : "#d4d4d4"
                        MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; anchors.margins: -22; onClicked: qmHeat.setYear(qmHeat.year + 1) }
                    }
                }
            }

            Item {
                id: qmGrid
                width: parent.width
                height: 2 * qmHeat.bandH + qmHeat.bandGap

                // month labels
                Repeater {
                    model: qmHeat.loaded ? 12 : 0
                    delegate: Text {
                        readonly property double firstMs: Date.UTC(qmHeat.year, index, 1)
                        readonly property int col: Math.floor((Math.round((firstMs - qmHeat.jan1Ms) / qmHeat.dayMsLen) + qmHeat.jan1Dow) / 7)
                        readonly property int band: index < 6 ? 0 : 1
                        x: qmHeat.labelW + (band === 0 ? col : col - qmHeat.julCol) * qmHeat.step
                        y: band * (qmHeat.bandH + qmHeat.bandGap)
                        text: qmHeat.monthNames[index].toLowerCase()
                        color: "#8c8c8c"
                        font.family: qmHome.mono
                        font.pixelSize: 20
                    }
                }

                Item {
                    id: qmCells
                    x: qmHeat.labelW
                    y: 0
                    width: qmHeat.colsPerBand * qmHeat.step
                    height: qmGrid.height

                    Repeater {
                        model: qmHeat.loaded ? qmHeat.daysInYear : 0
                        delegate: Rectangle {
                            readonly property double dayMs: qmHeat.jan1Ms + index * qmHeat.dayMsLen
                            readonly property string key: qmHeat.keyOf(dayMs)
                            readonly property int lvl: qmHeat.level(qmHeat.totals[key])
                            readonly property bool selected: key === qmHeat.selKey
                            readonly property var pos: qmHeat.cellPos(dayMs)
                            readonly property bool future: dayMs > qmHeat.todayMs
                            x: pos.x
                            y: pos.y
                            width: qmHeat.cell
                            height: qmHeat.cell
                            color: future ? "white" : qmHeat.shades[lvl]
                            border.width: (future || lvl === 0) ? 1 : 0
                            border.color: future ? "#ebebeb" : "#b4b4b4"

                            Rectangle {
                                visible: parent.selected
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                anchors.margins: -Math.ceil(qmHeat.gap / 2) - 1
                                color: "transparent"
                                border.width: 3
                                border.color: "black"
                                z: 2
                            }
                            Rectangle {
                                visible: parent.key === qmHeat.todayKey && !parent.selected
                                anchors.centerIn: parent
                                width: Math.max(4, Math.round(qmHeat.cell / 4))
                                height: width
                                color: parent.lvl >= 3 ? "white" : "black"
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Tap a day to open it; swipe sideways to change year.
                MouseArea {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    anchors.margins: -12
                    preventStealing: true
                    property real sx: 0
                    property real sy: 0
                    function keyAt(mx, my) {
                        var px = mx - 12 - qmHeat.labelW, py = my - 12;
                        if (px < 0) return "";
                        var stride = qmHeat.bandH + qmHeat.bandGap;
                        var band = py >= stride ? 1 : 0;
                        var inBand = py - band * stride - qmHeat.monthH;
                        if (inBand < 0) return "";
                        var col = Math.floor(px / qmHeat.step) + (band === 1 ? qmHeat.julCol : 0);
                        var row = Math.min(6, Math.floor(inBand / qmHeat.step));
                        var dayIdx = col * 7 + row - qmHeat.jan1Dow;
                        if (dayIdx < 0 || dayIdx >= qmHeat.daysInYear) return "";
                        var ms = qmHeat.jan1Ms + dayIdx * qmHeat.dayMsLen;
                        if ((band === 0) !== (ms < qmHeat.jul1Ms)) return "";  // day belongs to the other half
                        return ms <= qmHeat.todayMs ? qmHeat.keyOf(ms) : "";
                    }
                    onPressed: function(m) { sx = m.x; sy = m.y; }
                    onReleased: function(m) {
                        var dx = m.x - sx, dy = m.y - sy;
                        if (Math.abs(dx) > 100 && Math.abs(dx) > 1.5 * Math.abs(dy)) {
                            qmHeat.setYear(qmHeat.year + (dx < 0 ? 1 : -1));   // swipe left = next year
                        } else if (Math.abs(dx) < 30 && Math.abs(dy) < 30) {
                            var k = keyAt(m.x, m.y);
                            if (k !== "") qmHeat.select(k, true);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // legend
            Row {
                anchors.right: parent.right
                spacing: 6
                Text { text: "less "; font.family: qmHome.mono; font.pixelSize: 18; color: "#8c8c8c"; anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter }
                Repeater {
                    model: 5
                    delegate: Rectangle {
                        width: 18; height: 18
                        color: qmHeat.shades[index]
                        border.width: index === 0 ? 1 : 0
                        border.color: "#b4b4b4"
                    }
                }
                Text { text: " more"; font.family: qmHome.mono; font.pixelSize: 18; color: "#8c8c8c"; anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter }
            }

            // ---- selected day ----
            Column {
                id: qmDetail
                visible: qmHeat.selKey !== ""
                width: parent.width
                spacing: 20

                Item {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: qmDayTitle.height
                    Column {
                        id: qmDayTitle
                        spacing: 2
                        Text {
                            text: qmHeat.selKey === "" ? "" : qmHeat.selKey + "  " + ["sun", "mon", "tue", "wed", "thu", "fri", "sat"][new Date(qmHeat.msOf(qmHeat.selKey)).getUTCDay()]
                            font.family: qmHome.mono
                            font.pixelSize: 30
                            font.bold: true
                            color: "black"
                        }
                        Text {
                            text: qmHeat.fmt(qmHeat.selTotal)
                            font.family: qmHome.mono
                            font.pixelSize: 24
                            color: "#8c8c8c"
                        }
                    }
                    MouseArea { anchors.fill: qmDayTitle; onClicked: qmHeat.detailOpen = !qmHeat.detailOpen }
                    Row {
                        anchors.right: parent.right
                        anchors.top: parent.top
                        spacing: 48
                        Repeater {
                            model: 3
                            delegate: Text {
                                text: index === 0 ? "<" : (index === 1 ? ">" : (qmHeat.detailOpen ? "−" : "+"))
                                font.family: qmHome.mono
                                font.pixelSize: 36
                                font.bold: true
                                color: (index === 1 && qmHeat.selKey === qmHeat.todayKey) ? "#d4d4d4" : "black"
                                MouseArea {
                                    anchors.fill: parent
                                    anchors.margins: -22
                                    onClicked: {
                                        if (index === 0) qmHeat.step(-1);
                                        else if (index === 1) qmHeat.step(1);
                                        else qmHeat.detailOpen = !qmHeat.detailOpen;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Column {
                    visible: qmHeat.detailOpen
                    width: parent.width
                    spacing: 20

                    Text {
                        visible: qmHeat.selTotal <= 0
                        text: "nothing recorded"
                        font.family: qmHome.mono
                        font.pixelSize: 24
                        color: "#8c8c8c"
                    }

                    // hourly bars
                    Item {
                        id: qmChart
                        visible: qmHeat.selTotal > 0
                        width: parent.width
                        height: 210
                        readonly property int axisH: 32
                        readonly property int capH: 30
                        readonly property int plotTop: capH
                        readonly property int plotH: height - axisH - plotTop
                        readonly property real slot: width / 24
                        readonly property int maxSecs: {
                            var m = 0;
                            for (var i = 0; i < qmHeat.selHours.length; i++) m = Math.max(m, qmHeat.selHours[i]);
                            return Math.max(m, 60);
                        }

                        Text {
                            visible: qmHeat.selHour >= 0
                            x: Math.max(0, Math.min(qmChart.width - width, qmHeat.selHour * qmChart.slot + qmChart.slot / 2 - width / 2))
                            y: 0
                            text: qmHeat.selHour < 0 ? "" : qmHeat.pad(qmHeat.selHour) + ":00  " + qmHeat.fmt(qmHeat.selHours[qmHeat.selHour] || 0)
                            font.family: qmHome.mono
                            font.pixelSize: 22
                            color: "black"
                        }
                        Rectangle {
                            x: 0
                            y: qmChart.plotTop + qmChart.plotH
                            width: qmChart.width
                            height: 1
                            color: "black"
                        }
                        Repeater {
                            model: 24
                            delegate: Item {
                                x: index * qmChart.slot
                                y: qmChart.plotTop
                                width: qmChart.slot
                                height: qmChart.plotH
                                readonly property int secs: qmHeat.selHours.length === 24 ? qmHeat.selHours[index] : 0
                                Rectangle {
                                    anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                                    anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                                    width: Math.max(4, parent.width - 14)
                                    height: parent.secs > 0 ? Math.max(3, parent.height * parent.secs / qmChart.maxSecs) : 0
                                    color: qmHeat.selHour === index || qmHeat.selHour < 0 ? "black" : "#b4b4b4"
                                }
                                MouseArea {
                                    anchors.fill: parent
                                    onClicked: qmHeat.selHour = (qmHeat.selHour === index ? -1 : index)
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        Repeater {
                            model: [0, 6, 12, 18]
                            delegate: Text {
                                x: modelData * qmChart.slot + (qmChart.slot - width) / 2
                                y: qmChart.plotTop + qmChart.plotH + 8
                                text: qmHeat.pad(modelData)
                                font.family: qmHome.mono
                                font.pixelSize: 20
                                color: "#8c8c8c"
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // notebooks
                    Column {
                        visible: qmHeat.selDocs.length > 0
                        width: parent.width
                        spacing: 4
                        Repeater {
                            model: qmHeat.selDocs
                            delegate: Item {
                                width: parent.width
                                height: 38
                                Text {
                                    anchors.left: parent.left
                                    anchors.right: qmDocTime.left
                                    anchors.rightMargin: 32
                                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                    elide: Text.ElideRight
                                    text: modelData.name
                                    font.family: qmHome.mono
                                    font.pixelSize: 26
                                    color: "black"
                                }
                                Text {
                                    id: qmDocTime
                                    anchors.right: parent.right
                                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                    text: qmHeat.fmt(modelData.secs)
                                    font.family: qmHome.mono
                                    font.pixelSize: 26
                                    color: "#8c8c8c"
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            Text {
                visible: qmHeat.loaded && Object.keys(qmHeat.totals).length === 0
                width: parent.width
                wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                text: "no data yet — open a notebook or PDF."
                font.family: qmHome.mono
                font.pixelSize: 24
                color: "#8c8c8c"
            }
        }
    }
END SLOT
